preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the multipleBotlistAddress() function with an array containing victim addresses and set the excluded parameter to true. This will blacklist those addresses, preventing them from making any transfers while allowing the owner to continue trading normally.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The TokenTool contract has an owner-only function `multipleBotlistAddress()` that can blacklist any address. When an address is blacklisted, it cannot send or receive tokens due to the check in `_transfer()`. This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can arbitrarily restrict any address from trading while continuing to trade normally themselves.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call `multipleBotlistAddress()` to blacklist a victim address. This will set `_isBlacklisted[victim] = true`, satisfying the oracle verification.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call multipleBotlistAddress() with an array containing the victim address and excluded=true. 4. Verify that _isBlacklisted[victim] is now true.
